description: This file defines the StorageService class which manages local storage for a book reader application, including database operations for books, bookmarks, downloads, and reading progress via sqflite, and preferences via SharedPreferences.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Provides methods to initialize storage, manage books, bookmarks, downloads, reading progress, and preferences for the reading app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SharedPreferences and opens/creates the database with necessary tables.

methods.name: upsertBook
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a book record in the database.

methods.name: getAllBooks
methods.description: Retrieves all books from the database ordered by title.

methods.name: saveBookmark
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a bookmark record in the database.

methods.name: getBookmarks
methods.description: Retrieves all bookmarks for a given book ID.

methods.name: setReadingProgress
methods.description: Sets the reading progress for a specific book.

methods.name: getReadingProgress
methods.description: Retrieves the reading progress for a specific book.

methods.name: setPrefString
methods.description: Sets a string preference key-value pair.

methods.name: setPrefDouble
methods.description: Sets a double preference key-value pair.

methods.name: getPrefString
methods.description: Retrieves a string preference value for a given key.

methods.name: getPrefDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double preference value for a given key, with optional default.
